results.name: targetHetFromFst
results.regime: Wright-Fisher binomial sampling in one deme from a common ancestor at p0 = 0.3, 300000 independent loci, t generations, no mutation; the observables are the realised mean heterozygosity and the additive-variance retention it implies for a fixed-effect score. fst is the MODEL's 1-(1-1/(2Ne))^t and shared_ld the model's (1-r)^(2t) -- neither is estimated from the replicates the oracle measures, which is what keeps this from being the battery_bulk21 identity. Ne, t and r are swept so the prediction spans a factor of four
